DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.shuttle_station_overall_view;

CREATE VIEW public.shuttle_station_overall_view AS

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- CONFIGURATION: change 'shuttle_station' and
-- 'shuttle_idle_time' to target a different station.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────

WITH config AS (
    SELECT
        'shuttle_station'  AS station_name,
        'shuttle_idle_time' AS exclude_metric   -- the idle_time metric for this station
),

-- Sum baseline means and combine stds (sqrt of sum of variances)
-- for all metrics of the station EXCEPT the idle_time metric
station_baseline AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(bm.mean)                        AS station_mean,
        SQRT(SUM(bm.std_dev * bm.std_dev))  AS station_std
    FROM public.baseline_metrics bm, config
    WHERE bm.station_name = config.station_name
      AND bm.metric_name  != config.exclude_metric
),

-- Sum live metric values per timestamp (excluding idle_time)
live_values AS (
    SELECT
        pm.timestamp AS time,
        SUM(pm.value) AS station_value
    FROM public.process_metrics pm, config
    WHERE pm.station_name = config.station_name
      AND pm.metric_name  != config.exclude_metric
      AND $__timeFilter(pm.timestamp)
    GROUP BY pm.timestamp
),

ordered AS (
    SELECT
        lv.time,
        lv.station_value                             AS value,
        sb.station_mean                              AS mean,
        sb.station_std                               AS std,
        sb.station_mean + 2.5 * sb.station_std       AS upper_2_5sigma,
        sb.station_mean - 2.5 * sb.station_std       AS lower_2_5sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lv.time)         AS rn
    FROM live_values lv
    CROSS JOIN station_baseline sb
),

rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        -- RULE 1: One point beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1,

        -- RULE 2: Nine or more consecutive points on the same side of the mean (Shift)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule2,

        -- RULE 3: Six consecutive points steadily increasing or decreasing (Drift/Trend)
        CASE
          WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          OR
            (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule3,

        -- RULE 4: Fourteen consecutive points alternating up and down (Oscillation)
        CASE
          WHEN
            (SIGN(value - LAG(value,1) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule4,

        -- RULE 5: Two of three consecutive points beyond 2σ on the same side (Early warning)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule5,

        -- RULE 6: Four of five consecutive points beyond 1σ on the same side (Gradual shift)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule6,

        -- RULE 7: Fifteen consecutive points within 1σ of the mean (Stratification)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) < std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 15
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule7,

        -- RULE 8: Eight consecutive points beyond 1σ on either side, none within 1σ (Mixture)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) > std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 8
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule8

    FROM ordered
    WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation
    FROM rules
)

SELECT
    time,
    value,
    mean,
    upper_2_5sigma,
    lower_2_5sigma,

    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,

    CASE
        WHEN any_violation THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ',
            CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Rule 1: Beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Rule 2: 9 same side (Shift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Rule 3: 6 trend (Drift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Rule 4: 14 alternating (Oscillation)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ (Early warning)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ (Gradual shift)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Rule 7: 15 within 1σ (Stratification)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'Rule 8: 8 beyond 1σ both sides (Mixture)' END
        )
        ELSE ''
    END AS rule_description

FROM final
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  time AS "time",
  mean,
  upper_2_5sigma,
  lower_2_5sigma,
  anomaly_point
FROM shuttle_station_overall_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.shuttle_station_shuttle_idle_time_view;

CREATE VIEW public.shuttle_station_shuttle_idle_time_view AS
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        pm.timestamp AS time,
        pm.value,
        bm.mean,
        bm.std_dev AS std,
        bm.mean + (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS upper_2_5sigma,
        bm.mean - (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_2_5sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.timestamp) AS rn
    FROM public.process_metrics pm
    JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm
      ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name
     AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name
    WHERE pm.station_name = 'shuttle_station'
      AND pm.metric_name = 'shuttle_idle_time'
),

rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        -- RULE 1: One point beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1,

        -- RULE 2: Nine or more consecutive points on the same side of the mean (Shift)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule2,

        -- RULE 3: Six consecutive points steadily increasing or decreasing (Drift/Trend)
        CASE
          WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          OR
            (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule3,

        -- RULE 4: Fourteen consecutive points alternating up and down (Oscillation)
        CASE
          WHEN
            -- Check alternating pattern over last 14 points using sign of differences
            (SIGN(value - LAG(value,1) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule4,

        -- RULE 5: Two of three consecutive points beyond 2σ on the same side (Early warning)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule5,

        -- RULE 6: Four of five consecutive points beyond 1σ on the same side
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule6,

        -- RULE 7: Fifteen consecutive points within 1σ of the mean (Stratification / reduced variation)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) < std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 15
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule7,

        -- RULE 8: Eight consecutive points beyond 1σ on either side, none within 1σ (Mixture / bimodal)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) > std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 8
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule8

    FROM ordered
    WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation
    FROM rules
)

SELECT
    time,
    value,
    mean,
    upper_2_5sigma,
    lower_2_5sigma,

    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,

    CASE
        WHEN any_violation THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ',
            CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Rule 1: Beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Rule 2: 9 same side (Shift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Rule 3: 6 trend (Drift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Rule 4: 14 alternating (Oscillation)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ (Early warning)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ (Gradual shift)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Rule 7: 15 within 1σ (Stratification)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'Rule 8: 8 beyond 1σ both sides (Mixture)' END
        )
        ELSE ''
    END AS rule_description

FROM final
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  time AS "time",
  mean,
  upper_2_5sigma,
  lower_2_5sigma,
  anomaly_point
FROM shuttle_station_shuttle_idle_time_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.shuttle_station_shuttle_pre_scan_time_view;

CREATE VIEW public.shuttle_station_shuttle_pre_scan_time_view AS
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        pm.timestamp AS time,
        pm.value,
        bm.mean,
        bm.std_dev AS std,
        bm.mean + (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS upper_2_5sigma,
        bm.mean - (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_2_5sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.timestamp) AS rn
    FROM public.process_metrics pm
    JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm
      ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name
     AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name
    WHERE pm.station_name = 'shuttle_station'
      AND pm.metric_name = 'shuttle_pre_scan_time'
),

rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        -- RULE 1
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1,

        -- RULE 2
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule2,

        -- RULE 3
        CASE
          WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          OR
            (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule3,

        -- RULE 5
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule5

    FROM ordered
    WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule5) AS any_violation
    FROM rules
)

SELECT
    time,
    value,
    mean,
    upper_2_5sigma,
    lower_2_5sigma,

    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,

    CASE
        WHEN any_violation THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ',
            CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Rule 1: Beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Rule 2: 9 same side (Shift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Rule 3: 6 trend (Drift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ' END
        )
        ELSE ''
    END AS rule_description

FROM final
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  time AS "time",
  mean,
  upper_2_5sigma,
  lower_2_5sigma,
  anomaly_point
FROM shuttle_station_shuttle_pre_scan_time_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

(2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_2_5sigma,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.timestamp) AS rn FROM public.process_metrics pm JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name WHERE pm.station_name = 'shuttle_station' AND pm.metric_name = 'shuttle_carrier_motion_time'), rules AS ( SELECT *, (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9 OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2, CASE WHEN (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w) OR (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + 2*std) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2 OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean -             (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule4,

        -- RULE 5: Two of three consecutive points beyond 2σ on the same side (Early warning)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule5,

        -- RULE 6: Four of five consecutive points beyond 1σ on the same side
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule6,

        -- RULE 7: Fifteen consecutive points within 1σ of the mean (Stratification / reduced variation)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) < std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 15
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule7,

        -- RULE 8: Eight consecutive points beyond 1σ on either side, none within 1σ (Mixture / bimodal)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) > std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 8
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule8

    FROM ordered
    WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation
    FROM rules
)

SELECT
    time,
    value,
    mean,
    upper_2_5sigma,
    lower_2_5sigma,

    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,

    CASE
        WHEN any_violation THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ',
            CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Rule 1: Beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Rule 2: 9 same side (Shift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Rule 3: 6 trend (Drift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Rule 4: 14 alternating (Oscillation)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ (Early warning)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ (Gradual shift)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Rule 7: 15 within 1σ (Stratification)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'Rule 8: 8 beyond 1σ both sides (Mixture)' END
        )
        ELSE ''
    END AS rule_description

FROM final
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  time AS "time",
  mean,
  upper_2_5sigma,
  lower_2_5sigma,
  anomaly_point
FROM shuttle_station_shuttle_scan_success_time_view

SELECT

  AND $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  value
FROM process_metrics
WHERE 
  metric_name = 'shuttle_carrier_motion_time'
  AND station_name = 'shuttle_station'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.shuttle_station_shuttle_carrier_motion_time_view;

CREATE VIEW public.shuttle_station_shuttle_carrier_motion_time_view AS
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        pm.timestamp AS time,
        pm.value,
        bm.mean,
        bm.std_dev AS std,
        bm.mean + (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS upper_2_5sigma,
        bm.mean - (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_2_5sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.timestamp) AS rn
    FROM public.process_metrics pm
    JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm
      ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name
     AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name
    WHERE pm.station_name = 'shuttle_station'
      AND pm.metric_name = 'shuttle_carrier_motion_time'
),

rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        -- RULE 1: One point beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1,

        -- RULE 2: Nine or more consecutive points on the same side of the mean (Shift)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 9
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule2,

        -- RULE 3: Six consecutive points steadily increasing or decreasing (Drift/Trend)
        CASE
          WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          OR
            (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w AND
             LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule3,

        -- RULE 4: Fourteen consecutive points alternating up and down (Oscillation)
        CASE
          WHEN
            -- Check alternating pattern over last 14 points using sign of differences
            (SIGN(value - LAG(value,1) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule4,

        -- RULE 5: Two of three consecutive points beyond 2σ on the same side (Early warning)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - 2*std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 2
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule5,

        -- RULE 6: Four of five consecutive points beyond 1σ on the same side
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value > mean + std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          OR
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value < mean - std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 4
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule6,

        -- RULE 7: Fifteen consecutive points within 1σ of the mean (Stratification / reduced variation)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) < std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 15
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule7,

        -- RULE 8: Eight consecutive points beyond 1σ on either side, none within 1σ (Mixture / bimodal)
        CASE
          WHEN
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(value - mean) > std)
            OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 8
          THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS rule8

    FROM ordered
    WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation
    FROM rules
)

SELECT
    time,
    value,
    mean,
    upper_2_5sigma,
    lower_2_5sigma,

    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,

    CASE
        WHEN any_violation THEN CONCAT_WS(' | ',
            CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Rule 1: Beyond 3σ (Extreme outlier)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Rule 2: 9 same side (Shift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Rule 3: 6 trend (Drift detected)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Rule 4: 14 alternating (Oscillation)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ (Early warning)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ (Gradual shift)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Rule 7: 15 within 1σ (Stratification)' END,
            CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'Rule 8: 8 beyond 1σ both sides (Mixture)' END
        )
        ELSE ''
    END AS rule_description

FROM final
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  time AS "time",
  mean,
  upper_2_5sigma,
  lower_2_5sigma,
  anomaly_point
FROM shuttle_station_shuttle_carrier_motion_time_view
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  time,
  'Nelson Rule Violation' AS title,
  rule_description AS text
FROM shuttle_station_shuttle_carrier_motion_time_view

  AND $__timeFilter(time)
